notes.title: Patch Note - Update 1.1.1
notes.content:
[b]fixed the graphics bug with creature eyes:[/b]
-the creatures' eyes protrude abnormally from their heads

notes.title: Patch Note - Update 1.1.0
notes.content:
[b]Added highlight effect on important objects:[/b]
        -Important items will now be highlighted to make them easier for players to spot.

[b]Added a particle effect when hitting structures made of flesh with the hammer:[/b]
         -Structures, such as enemies or in-game items, made of flesh will now react with a dynamic particle effect when the player uses the hammer. This will improve the visual experience when attacking these entities.

[b]Added the ability to break the padlock by shooting it with the gun:[/b]
         -Players now have the ability to destroy the padlock using their pistol. This functionality offers an alternative to traditional key usage

[b]Improved haptic feedback:[/b]
         -Haptic feedback has been improved for a more immersive tactile experience.

[b]Improved sounds when hitting objects on structures:[/b]
         -Sounds during attacks with objects on structures have been improved for an enhanced hearing experience.

[b]Added loot and monsters when the player breaks the fleshballs:[/b]
         -By breaking the fleshballs, players can now discover additional loot and encounter the new type of creature.



(This update follows the feedback seen in a video) https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YsPACyYWHYQ

notes.title: Alpha 1.4.4 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hello,

In this update,
we added the possibility to crouch with a button,
you can still crouch without using the button.

we have also added 2 new parameters.
body height: allow to modify the size relative to the vr headset
Reset body : allow to reset the size to the position of the vr headset
